subject: Temporary rate ladder + overrun reconciliation for KiteWorks launch
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@kiteworks.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary headroom & billing path for your launch

Hi Alex / Patricia,

Congrats on the upcoming launch — excited to support KiteWorks. We reviewed the expected traffic profile you sent and can provision a short-term quota uplift and a managed overrun path to avoid any throttling during the first two weeks post-launch.

Summary of what we can offer (provisional):
- Temporary rate ladder (14 days): base committed QPS + provisional headroom of 3x for peak windows.
- Blended overrun pricing for the uplift period: base rate for committed units, 1.4x for first bracket above commit, 2.0x thereafter.
- Monthly true-up: any overrun will be reconciled on the following month’s invoice (detailed below).

I attached a short PDF that sketches the ladder and a redline-ready Master Amendment for accounting. Can you confirm:
1) whether KiteWorks can issue a PO for a provisional uplift or prefers post-invoice payment?
2) expected launch date/time (UTC) and main billing contact?

If you confirm by EOD Tue we can queue the capacity and cut an amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: KiteWorks-temp-rate-ladder-v1.pdf, MA-draft-kiteworks.docx

From: Alex Rivera <alex@kiteworks.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteWorks Finance <finance@kiteworks.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom & billing path for your launch

Thanks Rachel — this looks promising. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) When you say “monthly true-up,” does KiteWorks get invoiced after the uplift period (i.e., we run for two weeks, you invoice at month end), or do you invoice as you consume during the month? Our finance team prefers a single post-period invoice.
2) Can you confirm the exact thresholds for the ladder (we'd like an explicit tokens/day cap per bracket so we can map it to internal alarms).
3) Is there any way to lock the blended overrun rate if we commit to a short-term minimum spend? (Patricia — looping you in for PO/timing)

Launch ETA: target window is Apr 9 2027, 14:00 UTC (subject to final QA). Finance contact is finance@kiteworks.com.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Product, KiteWorks
alex@kiteworks.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@kiteworks.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom & billing path for your launch

Hi Alex / Patricia — Ben here (supporting Rachel on the commercial side). Quick answers and a concrete proposal so you can share with Finance: 

Operational mechanics
- We provision provisional headroom on Apr 8 (24h prior) and lift the quota automatically for the 14-day window.
- Metering continues in real-time; nothing is charged until invoicing, but we track consumption per bracket.

Proposed two-week ladder (example numbers; final will mirror your expected traffic):
- Bracket A (committed): up to 100M tokens — billed at committed rate ($0.004 / 1k tokens).
- Bracket B (uplift): next 200M tokens — billed at 1.4x committed rate ($0.0056 / 1k tokens).
- Bracket C (excess): any tokens beyond Bracket A+B — billed at 2.0x committed rate ($0.008 / 1k tokens).

Billing & true-up
- Invoice cadence: single consolidated invoice at month-end that includes the uplift window consumption (this matches KiteWorks preference).
- If you sign the attached Master Amendment before Apr 6, we can guarantee the blended rates above for the uplift window.
- Any mid-month changes will be prorated.

Next steps
1) I’ll attach a narrow amendment (sent with Rachel) for signature — DocuSign option available.
2) Patricia/Finance: if you can share a PO number, we’ll mark the uplift as provisioned on our side.

Attaching: MA-draft-kiteworks.docx (redline) and a sample ladder PDF for the billing team.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@kiteworks.com>

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few items from Finance: 

- We can provide a PO for the provisional uplift but need the final dollar estimate (based on your bracket assumptions) to include on the PO. Can you provide an estimated invoice amount range if we hit Bracket B but not C?
- We’d like to lock the blended rates if KiteWorks commits to a 3-month minimum spend of $45k/month. Is Redwood able to offer that?
- Please send the DocuSign when ready.

Patricia (Finance) added: our tax team also needs the Redwood tax ID on the invoice — can you confirm?

—Patricia
Patricia Gomez
Director of Finance, KiteWorks
patricia.gomez@kiteworks.com

Patricia / Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Final clarifications and next steps below.

Estimate for Bracket B (using the proposed ladder and your expected uplift profile):
- If KiteWorks consumes Bracket B only (no C): estimate $18k–$28k for the 14-day window (this will appear on the consolidated month-end invoice). Exact amount depends on daily shape; we’ll provide a pro forma invoice when the uplift is provisioned.

Rate lock & minimum spend
- We can offer a conditional rate lock at the blended overrun rates if KiteWorks signs a 3-month minimum commitment of $45k/month. The lock will be active for the duration of the committed term and will be reflected in the Master Amendment.

Procurement & Docs
- I’ve uploaded the redline to HubSpot (link below) and initiated DocuSign for the MA amendment. Please review and sign by Apr 6 to guarantee provisioning.
- PO should be sent to finance@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject line. Our tax ID: Redwood Inference, EIN 13-5790217.

Links and contacts
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7601
- DocuSign (amendment): https://www.docusign.com/affiliate/txn/0A1B2C3D

Next steps (timeline)
- Apr 6: sign amendment or send PO — we’ll queue capacity once either is received.
- Apr 8: provisional uplift becomes active (24h pre-launch) — you confirm by replying to this thread.
- Month-end: consolidated invoice with uplift true-up.

If that works, we’ll mark the deal and update the HubSpot stage to "Provisioned - Launch" after DocuSign.

Thanks,
